score_guide.0: Fails the criterion or has no supporting evidence.
score_guide.1: Has a material gap that blocks reliable use.
score_guide.2: Partly meets the criterion, with a material gap.
score_guide.3: Meets the criterion with evidence and no material gap found.
score_guide.4: Meets the criterion strongly, with specific evidence for the stronger result.

dimensions.name: Behavior and correctness
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether the shown implementation satisfies the stated task and handles visible edge cases.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the relevant implementation and any supplied checks.

dimensions.name: Security and data handling
dimensions.criterion: Assess trust boundaries, input handling, secrets, and unsafe behavior visible in the packet.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the affected code or state that the packet does not show enough evidence.

dimensions.name: Maintainability
dimensions.criterion: Assess clarity, error handling, and fit with the requested scope.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite implementation evidence.

dimensions.name: Verification
dimensions.criterion: Assess only checks and results recorded in the packet.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite recorded check output; do not infer that an unlisted check ran.

dimensions.name: Compatibility
dimensions.criterion: Assess compatibility with interfaces or environments that the task identifies.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the relevant interface or environment evidence when applicable.

critical_conditions.description: The evaluated result exposes a live credential or private key.
The evaluated result can cause unapproved destructive data loss.

dimensions.name: Factual accuracy
dimensions.criterion: Assess factual claims against evidence supplied in the packet.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite each material claim or mark it unsupported.

dimensions.name: Completeness
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether the document covers the task scope and required content.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite relevant sections or identify missing evidence.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether the intended reader can understand the content and actions.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the text that supports the assessment.

dimensions.name: Traceability
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether important statements can be traced to supplied sources.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite source references in the packet.

dimensions.name: Visual readability
dimensions.criterion: Assess visible layout only when the packet contains visual evidence.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite included visual or layout evidence when applicable.

critical_conditions.description: A high-impact claim is presented as established without supporting packet evidence.
The document discloses sensitive information that is not needed for its task.

dimensions.name: Data integrity
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether structure, types, and relationships are preserved in the supplied sample.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the sample or recorded validation results.

dimensions.name: Privacy
dimensions.criterion: Assess exposure of sensitive data and whether the provided fields fit the stated task.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite fields or redaction evidence.

dimensions.name: Data quality
dimensions.criterion: Assess visible completeness, consistency, and validity.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite supplied data or checks.

dimensions.name: Lineage
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether source and collection details are recorded.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite supplied provenance fields.

dimensions.name: Fitness for use
dimensions.criterion: Assess suitability only for the stated downstream use.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the task and relevant data evidence.

critical_conditions.description: The packet exposes personal or secret data beyond what the task needs.
The evaluated transformation silently loses or corrupts data needed by the task.

dimensions.name: Configuration correctness
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether settings match the stated behavior and environment.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the setting and its stated purpose.

dimensions.name: Security
dimensions.criterion: Assess credential handling, permissions, and exposed services.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the relevant setting.

dimensions.name: Compatibility
dimensions.criterion: Assess compatibility with versions and interfaces identified in the packet.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite declared versions or interfaces.

dimensions.name: Operational behavior
dimensions.criterion: Assess observability, failure behavior, and safe defaults.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the relevant configuration.

dimensions.name: Maintainability
dimensions.criterion: Assess ease of review and change for the stated owner.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the configuration structure when applicable.

critical_conditions.description: A credential or private key is exposed in the configuration.
A setting grants access broader than the task requires.

dimensions.name: Relevance
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether the target addresses the stated task.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite evidence from the target and task.

dimensions.name: Evidence quality
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether conclusions are supported by the supplied evidence.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite included evidence or mark the claim unsupported.

dimensions.name: Clarity
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether the intended user can understand the result.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the relevant content.

dimensions.name: Limitations
dimensions.criterion: Assess whether important unknowns and limits are made clear.
dimensions.required_evidence: Cite the stated limits or identify missing ones.

critical_conditions.description: The target exposes sensitive information that is not needed for its task.
A material conclusion is presented without support from the packet.
